summary: WF-03 Step 3 for ISS-0711/GH-802: implemented the prm-08 fixture fix per the validated design src/design/iss0711-gh802-prm08-fixture-fix.md (Type E, test-code ONLY). Patched tests/integration/prm-08-rollback-sandbox.test.zig exactly per the design: insertPromotionReviewsRow (helper 233-258) gained a requested_by param and now INSERTs the three NOT NULL columns requested_by/def_type/serialised_plan (def_type='rollback', serialised_plan='prm08-test-serialised-plan' sentinels); the single call site (TC-PRM-08-03, previously line 466) now generates a fresh UUID via randomUuidStr(alloc) and passes it. No production code and no migrations touched (rollback.zig = GH-803, seed logic = GH-804 both untouched). Verified by running zig build (exit 0) and BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test zig build test-integration-prm08 DIRECTLY (not the stale-5433 wrapper). Result: 3 pass, 1 fail (TC-PRM-08-03) — the sqlstate 23502 failure is GONE; the residual TC-PRM-08-03 failure is sqlstate 42883 in the production supersede UPDATE (def_id = $3::uuid vs TEXT column, GH-803) followed by the 'superseded' assertion finding 'approved' (GH-803 + GH-804 seed tenant/def_id mismatch) — both OUT OF SCOPE and documented, not fixed. Also surfaced and cleaned an environmental DB-pollution blocker: a prior run left prm08-pr-process v1/v2 rows in tenant_default.process_definitions (name/version UNIQUE uq_definition_version) that caused a transient 23505 on re-runs; cleaned from the test DB (DELETE via search_path incl. tenant_default so the audit trigger's unqualified audit_entries resolves) and documented in issues.

issues_found.description: Residual TC-PRM-08-03 failure: sqlstate 42883 (operator does not exist: text = uuid) in the production supersede UPDATE promotion_reviews ... def_id = $3::uuid against the TEXT column, swallowed by catch null so superseded_review_id is always null — this is ISS-0712/GH-803 (production src/definition/rollback.zig), OUT OF SCOPE for GH-802, tracked in its own run.

Residual TC-PRM-08-03 failure: the 'superseded' assertion finds 'approved' because TC-PRM-08-03 seeds the promotion_reviews row under a random tenant UUID + zero def_id which can never match the supersede WHERE (tenant_id=DEFAULT_TENANT_ID AND def_id=<active V2 id>) — this is ISS-0713/GH-804 (fixture seed-logic), OUT OF SCOPE for GH-802, tracked in its own run.

Environmental DB pollution: a prior run (pre-this-fix) left prm08-pr-process v1/v2 rows in tenant_default.process_definitions; because uq_definition_version UNIQUE(name, version) is not covered by the helper's ON CONFLICT (id), re-runs of test-integration-prm08 transiently fail with 23505 before reaching the rollback logic. dropTenantFixtures deletes by the current run's random def_ids only, so hardcoded-name leftovers persist across runs and the 'Cleaning test database' pre-step does not clear tenant_default.process_definitions for the default tenant. Cleaned the leftover rows from the test DB for this run's verification. Not caused by this patch; consider filing a test-isolation follow-up or having GH-804/clean step remove hardcoded-name rows.

psql on PATH resolves to a Copilot debug shim (debugCommand/psql.cmd) that ignores args and always runs 'SELECT 1' against docker db_test; real DB queries had to go through 'docker compose exec db_test psql' with search_path incl. tenant_default.

next_steps: Route to TEST-DESIGNER / next WF-03 step for GH-802 as ORCH directs; GH-802 acceptance criterion (23502 eliminated, no prod/migration change) is met.

GH-803 (production rollback.zig 42883) and GH-804 (seed tenant/def_id mismatch) remain the residual causes of the TC-PRM-08-03 assertion failure — sequence in their own runs to make the full test pass.
